result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, HDI-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, defense control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures. The Company's reciprocal indemnity is confined to Company-provided Content/Marks and its breach of law. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing commercial terms. Minor drafting issues include placing Section 9A after Section 10.7 and making prompt notice an absolute condition without a prejudice qualifier, but these do not prevent compliance.
